usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Israel statistics API, representative exchange rate USD/ILS (series RER_USD_ILS)
usdRate.note: Palestine has no currency of its own; the Israeli shekel is used for wages and prices (PCBS measures prices in shekels), while US dollars and Jordanian dinars are used for savings, loans and property. CLDR lists the dinar; the shekel is used here as the everyday currency. 3.118 shekels per US dollar on 30 October 2026.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: World Bank WDI, inflation, consumer prices (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG), West Bank and Gaza
inflation_cpi.note: 9.8% for 2025, the latest full year, used because the latest monthly figure is outside the range this field accepts: Trading Economics, citing PCBS, reports -25.2% year on year for Palestine in September 2026 as Gaza prices fell back from wartime peaks, while West Bank prices rose 3.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: PCBS consumer price index, West Bank annual changes 2019-2025 (about 1.9% average); Bank of Israel shekel inflation target 1-3%
inflation_projection.note: Prices are set mostly in shekels and West Bank inflation averaged about 2% over 2019-2025, but Gaza and supply shocks add risk, so 2.5% a year is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.note: The Palestine Monetary Authority has no national currency and sets no policy rate; shekel interest rates follow the Bank of Israel (3.25% in October 2026), dollar and dinar rates follow the Federal Reserve and the Central Bank of Jordan.

savings_account_rate.note: No current industry-wide savings account rate could be read. The Palestine Monetary Authority website loads its statistics only through scripts, so its interest-rate tables could not be read.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No current industry-wide 3-month term deposit rate could be read. The Palestine Monetary Authority website loads its statistics only through scripts, so its interest-rate tables could not be read.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No current industry-wide 1-year term deposit rate could be read. The Palestine Monetary Authority website loads its statistics only through scripts, so its interest-rate tables could not be read.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found. The Palestine Monetary Authority website loads its statistics only through scripts, so its interest-rate tables could not be read.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), West Bank and Gaza
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.24% for 2021, the latest year in the World Bank series (IMF data); older than 2025, mainly reflects dollar deposits, and is likely different now. The Palestine Monetary Authority website loads its statistics only through scripts, so its interest-rate tables could not be read.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Palestinian Authority has no domestic government securities market that could be found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No Palestinian Treasury bills were found; the Palestinian Authority does not issue government securities in a domestic market that could be found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No Palestinian government bonds were found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No Palestinian government bonds were found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The income tax treatment of bank interest for individuals could not be confirmed from the Ministry of Finance (site not reachable); PwC Tax Summaries does not cover Palestine.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists and no tax rule for such returns was found.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Palestine Deposit Insurance Corporation, deposit guarantee calculator
deposit_insurance_limit.note: The calculator caps compensation at USD 20,000 per depositor per member bank (deposits plus cash collateral less loans); converted at 3.118 shekels per dollar (Bank of Israel, 30 October 2026).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or average credit card rate could be read. The Palestine Monetary Authority website loads its statistics only through scripts, so its interest-rate tables could not be read.

equity_return_low.note: Low case: the small local stock market stays flat, as over much of the past decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate (2.24%, 2021); Bank of Israel rate 3.25%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: under 3 points above the deposit rate, well within the 4-point cap, because the local index has a weak 10-year record and few retail equity funds exist.

equity_return_high.note: High case: a recovery with stronger dividends, or global equity held from abroad.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Israel representative rate (3.118 ILS per USD, 30 October 2026; 3.45 in 2025)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a firm shekel.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Israel representative rate; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year, slightly reduced because the shekel has tended to strengthen against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Israel representative rate; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold years and a weaker shekel.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits paying about 1%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate (2.24%, 2021); Bank of Israel rate 3.25%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: slightly below the last published average deposit rate, since current rates and the tax on interest could not be read.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer shekel or dollar deposits near the policy rates.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Capital Market Authority (insurance regulator) publishes annual reports, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates per 1,000 of cover by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), West Bank and Gaza
oop_health_share.note: 42.1% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: PCBS consumer price index (health group index 114.9 in September 2026, base 2018); inflation assumption 2.5%
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have risen about 1.6% a year since 2018; 1 point above the 2.5% inflation assumption allows for private care costs rising faster.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: PCBS consumer price index (education group index 108.4 in September 2026, base 2018); inflation assumption 2.5%
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices have risen about 1% a year since 2018, but private school and university fees can jump, so 1 point above the 2.5% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), West Bank and Gaza
life_expectancy.note: 69.2 years in 2024 (men 65.2, women 74.3), lowered by the war in Gaza.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.58 (2025, World Bank), 9.2 (2040) and 19.7 (2065, populationpyramid.net/state-of-palestine/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: No private-sector pension is in force: the Ministry of Labour presents only a draft social security law (the 2016 decree-law, which set 60, is not applied), so private employees rely on the end-of-service gratuity. No current statutory pension age could be confirmed.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service pension age under the General Pension Authority could not be confirmed (its site could not be reached).

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: below the last published average deposit rate, since current rates and the tax on interest could not be read.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer shekel or dollar deposits near the policy rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate; equity base 5%; gold base 3.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, some equities and gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate; equity high 8%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found; the Ministry of Social Development's cash transfer programme targets poor households, and its rules could not be read (site not reachable).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found and the Ministry of Social Development site could not be reached.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Labour Law No. 7 of 2000, Article 45 (Ministry of Labour, Palestinian Gazette text)
gratuity_rule.note: A worker with at least one year of service gets one month's wage for each year, on the last wage without overtime, with part years counted. Article 42(2): on resignation only one third in the first five years and two thirds in the next five; full after ten years. Law text from 2000, still the labour law in force.

public_pension_scheme.note: Only public servants have a contributory pension (General Pension Authority), whose rules could not be read; private-sector social security exists only as a draft law presented by the Ministry of Labour.

savings_account.note: Accounts are held in shekels, US dollars or Jordanian dinars.

fdr_3m.note: Deposits are guaranteed up to USD 20,000 per depositor per bank.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No Palestinian Treasury bills were found.

tbond_5y.note: No Palestinian government bonds were found.

tbond_10y.note: No Palestinian government bonds were found.

equity_fund.note: No locally registered retail equity mutual funds were found; shares are traded on the local stock exchange through licensed brokers.

gold.note: Gold is mainly bought as jewellery and small bars from goldsmiths.

insuranceRegulator.name: Palestine Capital Market Authority, insurance directorate

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health, government health insurance
